response.sql: WITH country_averages AS (SELECT p.death_country, AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points_won FROM player_award_vote AS v JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = v.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.death_country) SELECT death_country, avg_points_won, avg_points_won - AVG(avg_points_won) OVER () AS difference_from_country_average FROM country_averages

assumptions.assumption: Only recorded death countries are included; each award-vote row contributes to its country's average. AVG ignores missing points_won values.

alternatives.interpretation: Include players with a missing death country as a separate NULL group.
